successcriteria.title: All non-text content that is presented to the user has a text alternative that serves the equivalent purpose, except for specified situations.
Text and images of text have a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1, with specified exceptions.
Visual information needed to identify user interface components and graphical objects has sufficient contrast.
All functionality is operable through a keyboard interface without requiring specific timings for individual keystrokes.
Any keyboard operable user interface has a mode of operation where the keyboard focus indicator is visible.
When a user interface component receives keyboard focus, it is not entirely hidden due to author-created content.
Targets for pointer inputs are at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels, or meet an exception.
Labels or instructions are provided when content requires user input.
This criterion has been removed from WCAG 2.2.
UI components expose appropriate names, roles, states and values to assistive technologies.
